title: Frame-local Surface resolution reuse

baseline_build.native_inputs: release Sokol and miniaudio; source paths match scripts/build.roc inputs --release
baseline_build.submodules: read-only source symlinks to the original checkout
baseline_build.build_note: Sandboxed Roc failed PermissionDenied. The approved normal build completed without errors or warnings.

method.mode: controlled windowed Bridge Lockstep CPU diagnostic
method.cpu_total: Sum the legacy Spans. Attribution fields overlap those Spans and do not enter the total.
method.derived_60hz: 2 * (input + step + commands + view + queries + query_results) + interpolation + ui_layout + cluster_build + render_submit + commit
method.derived_60hz_status: Derived two-step diagnostic; not observed real-clock work.
method.density_note: The original distance culling remains active. The initial selected view contains 21,973 field Draws; the tour end contains 22,000. No placement or visibility rule changed.
method.contention: Agent-owned heavy workloads stopped during measurement. Unrelated user processes remained running. Every run preserves its pre-launch process snapshot. The first baseline snapshot includes a seven-day-old engine process and other user applications.
method.sample_retention: Every CSV row is preserved, including loading, warmup, paused frames, and slow measured frames. Only explicit route boundaries and actual step counts select the controlled distribution.
method.gpu_status: No GPU-work measurement is claimed. CPU submission and Bridge Lockstep do not establish GPU work or pacing.
method.earlier_compiler_label: The earlier preliminary development-Roc label is unverified. The verified local compiler defaults to speed; all comparison binaries explicitly use --opt=speed.

attribution_note: Surface resolution measured p50 22.915 ms and p95 24.227 ms. Its median is about 86% of the original Interpolation median. The temporary diagnostic patch and raw samples are archived.

implementation.lifetime: One frame_render_draw call, after reload polling. No Roc pointer or key survives the call.
implementation.eligible: Whole-Draw Surface materials without named slots, explicit material or shader textures, or Draw-scope values.
implementation.key: Mesh ID and pointer, shader Pack and asset, scope, ordered parameters and properties, tags, and complete active payload bits.
implementation.failure: Cache only explicit complete success. Every failed Draw retains its original diagnostics.
implementation.per_draw: Capacity admission, skin accounting, transforms, bounds, tint, glow, selection and casting remain independent.

validation.native_tests: All tests passed. The signed-zero collision test first failed against the initial key and then passed after the bit-preserving correction.
validation.independent_review: Read-only review found no blocker in the final concrete diff.

excluded_runs.reason: These use the initial key before its signed-zero correction. All rows remain archived.
excluded_runs.pixel_reason: Native readback runs establish pixel parity. Their timings do not enter the controlled performance comparison.
excluded_runs.setup_reason: Sandbox socket access, missing Bridge Post serialization, retained execute mode, or executable-relative asset lookup stopped setup before any accepted measured range.

additional_raw_artifacts: PNG images, gzipped Bridge scenes, and retained binaries remain under /tmp/rocco-village-cpu-evidence. artifact-manifest.json records their hashes. The archive contains every CPU CSV and run metadata file, plus logs, Driver, diagnostic patch, and source snapshots.
